(law) a way of dealing with offenders without imprisoning them; a defendant found guilty of a crime is released by the court without imprisonment subject to conditions imposed by the court

vi_block: Sự thử thách (trước khi cho gia nhập tổ chức... ), sự tập sự; thời gian thử thách, thời gian tập sự.
Sự tạm tha có theo dõi; thời gian tạm tha có theo dõi.

examples: You'll be on probation for first six months. After that, if you work out, they'll hire you permanently.
wiktionary.gloss: A period of time when a person occupies a position only conditionally and may be removed if certain conditions are not met.

examples: He got two years probation for robbery.
wiktionary.gloss: A type of sentence where convicted criminals are permitted to continue living in a community but will automatically be sent to jail if they violate certain conditions.
A testing period of time.

blocks.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *h₂élisder.? From propose + -al.

senses.definition: a formal plan or suggestion that is offered for others to think about and decide

examples.en: The committee accepted the proposal for a new library.

senses.vi: sự đề xuất; kế hoạch đề xuất; điều đề nghị

senses.definition: an offer to marry someone

examples.en: She was surprised by his sudden marriage proposal.
examples.vi: Cô ấy bất ngờ trước lời cầu hôn bất ngờ của anh ấy.

senses.vi: sự cầu hôn; lời cầu hôn

thesaurus.definition: something proposed (such as a plan or assumption)
an offer of marriage
the act of making a proposal

Điều đề nghị, dự kiến đề nghị, kế hoạch đề xuất.

examples: proposals for the construction of a new building
wiktionary.gloss: A scheme or design.

examples: to make proposals for a treaty of peace
wiktionary.gloss: The terms or conditions proposed.
The document on which such a thing is written.
The act of asking someone to be one's spouse; an offer of marriage.
The offer by a party of what they have in view as to an intended business transaction, which, with acceptance, constitutes a contract.

tatoeba.vi: Tôi nghĩ rằng đề xuất của Tom là một đề suất tốt.

senses.definition: A small number or amount of things spread over an area.

senses.definition: The movement of light or particles in different directions after hitting something.

spreading widely or driving off
the act of scattering

tatoeba.en: The farmer is scattering seeds over the field.
tatoeba.vi: Người nông dân đang rải hạt giống xuống ruộng.

blocks.etymology: From Ancient Greek σωματικός (sōmatikós, “bodily”), σῶμα (sôma, “body”).

senses.definition: relating to the physical body of a living thing rather than the mind or spirit

examples.en: She suffered from somatic symptoms caused by chronic stress.
examples.vi: Cô ấy phải chịu đựng các triệu chứng thực thể do căng thẳng kéo dài.

senses.vi: (thuộc) thể; thuộc thể xác

senses.definition: relating to ordinary cells of an organism, not reproductive cells

examples.en: The disease is caused by somatic mutations in skin cells.
examples.vi: Căn bệnh này do các đột biến soma trong tế bào da gây ra.

senses.vi: (thuộc) xôma; thuộc tế bào sinh dưỡng

thesaurus.definition: affecting or characteristic of the body as opposed to the mind or spirit

wiktionary.gloss: Part of, or relating to the body of an organism.

examples: a somatic epitype
wiktionary.gloss: Pertaining, and restricted, to an individual; not inheritable.

examples: the somatic stalk of the yolk sac of an embryo
wiktionary.gloss: Of or relating to the wall of the body; somatopleuric; parietal.
